tool.name: Salmon quantmerge
tool.description: Merge multiple quantification results into a single file
tool.command: #import re #set $identifiers = [re.sub(r'[^\w\-]', '_', str($dataset.element_identifier)) for $dataset in $quants] #set $identifiers = ['_' + $identifier if $identifier.startswith('-') else $identifier for $identifier in $identifiers] #set $reserved_names = set($identifiers) #set $sample_names = [] #for $identifier in $identifiers: #set $sample_name = $identifier #set $suffix = 2 #if $sample_name in $sample_names: #set $sample_name = '%s_%s' % ($identifier, $suffix) #while $sample_name in $reserved_names: #set $suffix += 1 #set $sample_name = '%s_%s' % ($identifier, $suffix) #end while #end if #silent $reserved_names.add($sample_name) #silent $sample_names.append($sample_name) #end for #set $quant_filename = 'quant.genes.sf' if $genes else 'quant.sf' #for $counter, $input_data in enumerate($quants): mkdir '${counter}.quantmerge' && ln -s '${input_data}' '${counter}.quantmerge/${quant_filename}' && #end for salmon --no-version-check quantmerge --quants #for $counter, $input_data in enumerate($quants): '${counter}.quantmerge' #end for --names #for $sample_name in $sample_names: '${sample_name}' #end for --column '${column}' ${genes} #if str($missing) not in ('', 'None'): --missing '${missing}' #end if -o qmergeout.tab && test -s qmergeout.tab

param.label: Salmon quantification files
param.help: Select multiple quant.sf files or a list collection to produce one merged matrix. Column names come from dataset or collection element identifiers; colliding names receive a numeric suffix. For gene quantifications, select quant.genes.sf files and enable Gene-level input files.

param.label: Columns
param.help: Name of columns that will be merged in the output file

param.label: Gene-level input files
param.help: Enable for quant.genes.sf inputs. This does not aggregate transcript quantifications into genes.

param.label: Missing value
param.help: Leave empty to use NA, or enter a value such as 0 for transcripts or genes absent from a sample.

tool.help:
@salmonhelp@
-----
**Input datasets**
Multiple `quant.sf` files may be selected at once; a list collection of `quant.sf` files (for example the output of a Salmon quant step run on a collection of samples) can be handed to the input as well, in which case a single merged TPM, NumReads or length matrix is produced.
The column headers of the merged matrix are derived from the dataset identifiers; every character that is not a letter, a digit, an underscore or a hyphen is replaced by `_`. Names beginning with a hyphen are prefixed with `_`. If names collide after this conversion, numeric suffixes (`_2`, `_3`, ...) make them unique, preserving the names of other inputs and the input order.
Enable **Gene-level input files** when the inputs contain gene-level quantifications (`quant.genes.sf`). This option does not aggregate transcript-level quantifications into genes.
